text:
sam-support: Ping — acme-corp tenant reporting 403 when invoking models and can't access billing UI after the RBAC role/permission refactor rolled out this AM. They can list models but inference returns "permission_denied". Anyone else seeing rolesync lag or permission-graph inconsistencies? :eyes:

ben-security: On it. Any tenant IDs and example request ids? Also which region? Could be the new permission-graph cache TTL we tweaked yesterday.

sam-support: tenant=acme-corp, request_id=req_0a1b2c3d, region=us-west-2. Customer says issue started ~08:12 PST. I can repro a 403 on /v1/models/acme-llama/invoke with curl.

ellie-sre: I see spikes in rolesync latency in us-west-2 around that time. There was a partial roll of the role-mapping service that left older cache shards with a longer TTL. Quick mitigation: invalidate cache for the tenant and trigger rolesync.

iona-product: Can we do a safe invalidate? Need to avoid stomping production caches across tenants.

ellie-sre: Use the tenant-scoped command:
```
rbacctl invalidate-cache --tenant acme-corp --scope permission_graph
rbacctl trigger-rolesync --tenant acme-corp --force
```
I'll watch logs.

deploy-bot: rolesync-job 3f9b started for tenant=acme-corp by ellie-sre

sam-support: ran the two commands, got exit 0. Re-ran the failing curl, now returns 200 and model invocation succeeds. Customer also confirms billing UI is accessible again. :+1:

ben-security: Good. Please collect audit log window 08:10-08:20 PST and dump role assignments for acme-corp before/after. We need a short postmortem and a PR to revert the ttl change or add rolling invalidation.

sam-support: grabbing logs now. Example query I'll use:
```
aws logs filter --log-group /redwood/rbac --filter "tenant=\"acme-corp\" and action=\"invoke_model\"" --start 2026-03-10T08:10:00Z --end 2026-03-10T08:20:00Z
```

ellie-sre: Found the shard mismatch — patching the deploy to ensure all shards use the same 60s invalidation window. Will open a release revert/patch.

ben-security: Adding ticket RF-2047 for postmortem + customer follow-up. Assign to ellie-sre and sam-support.

sam-support: Noted. I'll message the customer with the timeline and next steps.

ellie-sre: Follow-up: will add a canary check to the rolesync pipeline to assert TTL uniformity across regions. :memo:

sam-support: closing this thread once ticket is created. Thanks all.
